messages:
marc: Quick postmortem follow-up for the ACME dedicated/on-prem outage. Need strict owners + a short validation checklist for the peering/isolation fixes.
anya: I can take the isolation repro & CI test. ETA: minimal repro by Thu, CI test by next Tue.
reza: Ill own the VPC peering ACLs and routing tweak. Blockers: customer routing creds + infra oncall approval. If creds arrive today, can target their maintenance window.
leah: Ill coordinate with ACME for creds and confirm their maintenance window (they offered Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC). Will also request BGP logs during the window.
ops-bot: Created tracker ticket: https://r-internal/tracker/INC-ACME-300 (fields: owner=unassigned, status=open).
marc: Assign owners now to avoid drift.
reža: (typo) reza: Assigned myself on tracker. Setting ETA for patch validation: 2026-04-10. Canary plan: announce limited prefix set, mirror traffic, verify no unexpected adverts.
anya: Repro notes: failure reproduces when on-prem NAT churn causes asymmetric egress and BGP keepalive loss. I'll add a NAT-churn test that toggles mappings every 30s.
safety: Security note: any change to advertisement rules needs extra verification to prevent route leakage. Ill run a quick sign-off once ACL diffs are posted.
reža: ACL draft posted in tracker. Snippet:
```
# ACL proposal
permit tcp 172.31.0.0/16 any eq 179
deny ip any 172.31.0.0/16
```
marc: Good. Please attach the exact AS-path checks for the canary.
leah: ACME confirmed they will stream BGP logs and allow temporary route updates during the window. They asked for rollback criteria.
reža: Rollback: if more than 5 unexpected prefixes announced or traffic drop >30% in mirrored sample, rollback immediately.
marc: Action recap:
- reza: ACL + route change, owner, ETA: Wed window, tracker INC-ACME-300
- anya: repro harness + CI, owner, ETA: Thu/Tue
- safety: sec sign-off, owner, meeting slot scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT
- leah: customer coordination + logs, owner
marc: Recurring incident pattern: this matches prior NAT/asym routing peering flaps (2 other customers). Long-term action: create peering-flap metric + auto-alert (owner: eng-sre).
anya: Ill draft a short runbook snippet for oncalls: reproduce -> canary steps -> rollback checklist. Posting draft by Fri.
ops-bot: Reminder: infra oncall approval required >=2h before any route change.
reža: Requesting temporary creds from infra now.
leah: Confirmed with ACME: they will provide creds for a 48h window if needed.
marc: Scheduling 15-min owners sync Fri 16:00 PT to check blockers. Please update tracker with statuses (blocked/in-progress/done). Closing condition: canary validated + no BGP resets recorded for 24h after change.
reža: Noted. Will mark blocked if creds/sec approval missing.
marc: Thanks everyone. Keep messages short in tracker updates so oncall can follow.
